reference: CTC official ST/SEG; silver reference, not manual Gold

training.selection: fixed final update 2000; no target-sequence checkpoint selection
training.scheduler: fixed cosine by optimizer update; no ReduceLROnPlateau
training.augmentation: unchanged shared native 256 random crop, flips, 90-degree rotation; no label interpolation
training.synthetic_to_grayscale: arithmetic RGB channel mean before same patch sampling

cellpose_sam.provenance: existing official generic cpsam_v2; original pretraining CTC exposure not established locally

initialization.rule: same checkpoint SHA across all four arms, seeds and directions of a model; no target-sequence-trained checkpoint

synthesis.candidate_generator: Same-class single-instance foreground resynthesis with the shared backbone and target-gated modulation; inverse projection to native scenes
synthesis.label_rule: native integer ST crop untouched; renderer-side auxiliary integer label is nearest binary support times target ID; normalized pair not used directly for downstream training
forbidden: connected components of binary union as instance labels
synthesis.selection: uniform train-side frame/crop requests, fixed seeds; retain all generated requests including poor appearances
synthesis.failure_policy: fail visibly on unreadable/missing artifacts; no target-guided replacement or appearance filtering

normalization.target_rule: one full ST semantic instance ID from training parent, including parts outside the selected native scene crop
normalization.native_edge_rule: clip square to parent and pad as existing isolate_instance; preserve labeled truncations; no Gold eligibility filter
normalization.native_alpha_and_integer_label: exact original parent L==ID; never inverse-resize labels
normalization.background: existing same-parent unlabeled-pixel matched single-instance background; native final background from the same parent outside all ST support

synthesis.reuse: one generated image per unique training parent/instance ID reused across overlapping native scenes; no cross-sequence reuse
synthesis.pure_synthetic_rule: render every positive ST ID in each native scene; replacing only a focal object and leaving real labeled neighbors would be hybrid and is not this arm
synthesis.foreground_contrast_condition: per-instance training-reference p1/p99 scalars explicitly used
synthesis.cache_key_rule: parent sequence/frame/ID + pixel hashes + geometry + seed + recipe + checkpoint hashes; excludes patch/arm/downstream seed

metrics.AP50: per-frame TP/(TP+FP+FN), cardinality-first one-to-one matches with instance IoU > 0.50; mean over full test frames
metrics.mAP_inst: mean of per-frame instance AP over IoU thresholds 0.50:0.05:0.95, then frame macro mean; not COCO confidence-ranked AP
metrics.Dice_fg: per-frame 2|P>0 intersect G>0|/(|P>0|+|G>0|), both-empty=1; frame macro mean
metrics.PQ: secondary exp5 endpoint, IoU > 0.5; pooled TP/FP/FN and matched IoU
metrics.test_resolution: native full FOV; fixed model postprocessing shared across four arms
metrics.direction_aggregation: report each direction; arithmetic mean of directions within dataset; optional equal-weight dataset macro mean
metrics.seed_aggregation: per-model/arm mean and sample SD across 42/43/44; paired same-seed arm differences; optional t95 interval df=2 conditional on fixed sequences
metrics.replication: 92 consecutive frames per sequence are subsamples; 2 sequences per dataset; training seeds are optimization replicates
